person.name: Thomas Brown
person.text: **Chief Medical Officer of Sygnomics** and **Board Treasurer of the Andy Hill CARE Fund** (Washington State cancer research fund). Medical oncologist focused on **gastrointestinal cancers** and **early-phase (I/II) drug trials**. Former **Executive Director of the Swedish Cancer Institute** (Seattle, from 2013), where he created the SCI Personalized Medicine Program; co-chaired the Providence St. Joseph Health **Cancer Leadership Council** and **Genomics Initiative**. Earlier: COO and professor at the **University of Arizona Cancer Center**, professor and VP at **MD Anderson**, faculty at **Duke** (GI cancer program, community trial consortium). MD Medical College of Virginia, internal medicine at University of Florida, oncology fellowship at **Johns Hopkins**, **MBA from Rice** (Jones Scholar).

company.text: Sygnomics (Seattle, founded 2020) builds on technology from the **Institute for Systems Biology (ISB)**. Its **SYGNAL** platform runs systems-biology **causal network analysis** on a tumor's transcriptomic / multi-omics profile, rather than mutations alone, to predict risk of progression and identify therapies likely to work. It offers a lab-developed test report to oncologists and plans to partner with pharma on **biomarkers and new indications**. It went through **Creative Destruction Lab** (Seattle, Computational Health, 2023/24). CEO per the Oct 1 call notes: **Ashutosh Tiwari** (spelling to be confirmed). Funding: not published.

history.text: LinkedIn InMail (as Dmitri). Thomas accepted, explained Sygnomics **does not run clinical trials** but is **interested in collaborations with CROs**, and offered slots. Dmitri asked for a time before 11:00 AM PDT (he is in Europe); they agreed on **Oct 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT**, with **thomas.brown@sygnomics.net** for the invite. Box created Sep 30 by Johanna T. **Call held Oct 1** with Dmitri, Francesco, Andrea and Sergey: partnership model discussed (Sygnomics technology + Valos clinical development, biostatistics, data management, programming, validation); use case: **retrospective blinded validation**, possibly a **pancreatic cancer Phase II**. Thomas agreed to share the **deck, ASCO posters and a publication** and to introduce Dmitri to the CEO and IT/AI team. Moved to Connected on Oct 6. No follow-up logged since.

industry.title: AI biomarkers need statistical proof
industry.text: Regulators and pharma expect pre-specified, blinded validation of AI-derived biomarkers before using them in trials or companion diagnostics.

industry.title: Transcriptomic signatures in oncology
industry.text: RNA-based prognostic and predictive signatures are moving into trial enrichment, especially in hard-to-treat cancers such as pancreatic.

industry.title: Startups partner with CROs
industry.text: Early-stage diagnostics companies often team up with CROs for joint pharma offers instead of building trial capability themselves.
